design.eligible_pool: preference rows whose decision is selected or quota_surplus; fixed inputs for all trials
design.quotas: Released number of rows in each family (verified against the export), identical under A/B/C
design.pairing: One global permutation per repetition, same ordered candidates and quotas for all policies. Random(seed + iteration), starting from numeric candidate-ID order.

policies.A_random: First q candidates in each family; uniform without replacement after shuffling.
policies.B_labels: Greedy minimum sum of already-selected counts for candidate task, profile, reason inside family; tie goes to earliest shared position.
policies.C_length_labels: Greedy minimum (count in candidate chosen-shorter boolean group, sum of three label counts). Equal joins not-shorter. Same tie-break as B.

definitions.length: Python len on entire Unicode response, including code, whitespace and punctuation; no tokenizer.
definitions.short_rate_REASON: Strictly shorter chosen inside that reason / all selected examples of the same reason.
definitions.long_heuristic: Expected accuracy of always choosing the longer response; tied lengths score 0.5. Mathematically (long_count + 0.5 * equal_count) / N.
definitions.majority_direction_heuristic: The larger of long_heuristic and 1 - long_heuristic, computed per selected set; best single global length direction in hindsight, not a trained or held-out model.
definitions.local_tv_AXIS: Family-quota-weighted mean of 0.5 * sum_c |observed fraction in family - 1/K| over the K eligible-pool categories of that axis. Smaller is closer to uniform.
definitions.local_tv_avg: Simple mean of the three family-weighted TV values. Fractions and TV are reported on a 0..1 scale.
definitions.summary: Mean, sample SD (ddof=1), observed min/max over the permutations of this one fixed eligible pool. Counts are numbers of pairs.
definitions.paired_differences_pp: Per-permutation treatment minus control in percentage points (100 times the difference of fractions/TV). A SD of zero means a fixed result across these repeats.
definitions.limits: Describes selection composition and tie-break sensitivity on one fixed synthetic pool. It measures neither training outcomes nor learning outcomes.
